mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y real GDP growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, signaled by a 3% decline in the INDPRO index over 6 months, indicates a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines by > 3% over 6 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, especially if the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5 percentage points in 3 months, signals labor market weakness that will weigh on consumer spending and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will negatively impact consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines by > 10% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS grows by > 5% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will prompt the Fed to tighten monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 3% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
